Fervo declared commercial operation for GeoBlock 1 at Cape Station on Sept. 30, ahead of its contractual deadline, and expects GeoBlocks 2 and 3 to reach commercial operation by Jan. 1, 2027, completing Phase I. "In the third quarter, Cape Station achieved a major milestone, reaching first power and contractual commercial operation," CEO Tim Latimer said in the release.


## Village Farms Posts Record $55 Million in Cannabis Sales


Village Farms International (VFF) reported record cannabis revenue of $55.0 million within total sales of $66.9 million, according to the[company's earnings release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001584549/000119312526452618/vff-ex99_1.htm) . International cannabis exports rose 75% from a year earlier to $20.8 million.


Net income attributable to shareholders was $10.0 million, or $0.08 per share, and adjusted EBITDA from continuing operations was $18.2 million, or 27% of sales. "We also delivered our sixth consecutive quarter of positive net income and EPS," said President and CEO Michael DeGiglio.


## Quantum Computing Inc. Revenue Rises to $9.5 Million


Quantum Computing Inc. (QUBT) lifted revenue to $9.5 million from $384,000 a year earlier, driven primarily by businesses acquired in the first half of 2026, including Luminar Semiconductors and NuCrypt, according to[its release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001758009/000162828026072163/q3-26earningspressreleasex.htm) . Gross margin was 4.5% and the net loss was $15.1 million.


Contract backlog stood at about $39.1 million at quarter end. CEO Yuping Huang said QCi's "focus is increasingly shifting from what we can build to what we can put to work for customers."


## Peloton Guides Q2 Revenue to $625 Million to $650 Million


In its fiscal first quarter, Peloton's gross margin reached 61.3% and GAAP net income was $96.2 million, according to[the company's release](https://menafn.com/1111919969/Peloton-Announces-Q1-FY2027-Financial-Results) . Adjusted EBITDA climbed 42% to $167.8 million, while paid connected fitness subscriptions fell 9% to 2.475 million.


For the second quarter, Peloton expects revenue of $625 million to $650 million and gross margin of about 50%. Its fiscal 2027 outlook calls for revenue of $2.30 billion to $2.40 billion. "Our Q1 results underscore the strength of our business and reinforce the trajectory of our multi-year transformation," CEO Peter Stern said.


## IMAX Posts Record $712 Million Global Box Office


IMAX's global box office reached a record $712 million in the quarter, and its GAAP result of $1.96 per diluted share included a $36.7 million deferred tax valuation allowance release worth $0.63 per share, according to the[company's earnings release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000921582/000162828026070630/imax-q32026epr.htm) . Adjusted EBITDA rose 133% to $120.9 million, a 69.3% margin. "What IMAX achieved goes beyond simply a 'great quarter' and transcends the many records we shattered in the period," CEO Rich Gelfond said.
